title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C Security Standards for the Protection of Electronic Protected Health Information

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(1)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish and maintain security measures that manage risks to electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of risks and vulnerabilities to electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce identified risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(C) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Apply appropriate sanctions to workforce members who fail to comply with security policies and procedures.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Regularly review records of information-system activity, including audit logs, access reports, and incident tracking.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(2) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Assign security responsibility to an identified security official.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(3)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement procedures that ensure workforce members have appropriate access and prevent access by those who should not have it.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(A) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Authorize workforce members who need access to electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(B) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Determine workforce-member access to electronic protected health information through authorization and supervision procedures.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(C) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Terminate access when a workforce member leaves or no longer needs it.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(4)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(4)(ii)(A) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: When a clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, protect its electronic protected health information from unauthorized access by that organization.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(4)(ii)(B) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information through appropriate system resources.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(4)(ii)(C) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish, document, review, and modify users’ access rights under the organization’s access authorization policies.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(5)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement a security awareness and training program for workforce members, including management.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(5)(ii)(A) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Provide periodic security reminders to the workforce.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(5)(ii)(B) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Protect against, detect, and report malicious software.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(5)(ii)(C) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Monitor log-in attempts and report discrepancies.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(5)(ii)(D) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish and change passwords as needed to support access security.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(6)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents, mitigate harmful effects, and document outcomes.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(6)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish and implement procedures for responding to and reporting security incidents.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish policies and procedures for responding to emergencies that damage systems containing electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(ii)(A) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(ii)(B) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Restore lost data and information after an emergency.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(ii)(C) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Continue critical business processes while protecting electronic protected health information during an emergency.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(ii)(D) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Test and revise emergency procedures periodically.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(7)(ii)(E) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Assess the criticality of applications containing electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(a)(8) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Periodically evaluate security policies, procedures, and technical and nontechnical measures.

clauses.title: § 164.308(b) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Obtain satisfactory assurances from business associates that they will safeguard electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.308(b)(3) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Document satisfactory assurances through a written contract or other arrangement.

clauses.title: § 164.310(a)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Limit physical access to facilities while ensuring authorized access is permitted.

clauses.title: § 164.310(a)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish procedures for facility access that support restoration after an emergency or other occurrence.

clauses.title: § 164.310(a)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish facility security plans and safeguards against unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

clauses.title: § 164.310(a)(2)(iii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Control and validate access to facilities based on a person’s role or function.

clauses.title: § 164.310(a)(2)(iv) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Document security-related repairs and modifications to facility components such as hardware, walls, doors, and locks.

clauses.title: § 164.310(b) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement policies and procedures for workstation use that protect electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.310(c) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement physical safeguards for workstations that access electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.310(d)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement policies and procedures for receipt, removal, and movement of electronic media containing protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.310(d)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Dispose of electronic protected health information and the media on which it is stored securely.

clauses.title: § 164.310(d)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Remove electronic protected health information from electronic media before reuse.

clauses.title: § 164.310(d)(2)(iii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Maintain records of hardware and electronic media movements and responsible persons.

clauses.title: § 164.310(d)(2)(iv) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Create retrievable copies of electronic protected health information before moving equipment.

clauses.title: § 164.312(a)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow access only to authorized persons or software programs.

clauses.title: § 164.312(a)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Assign a unique name or number to identify and track each user.

clauses.title: § 164.312(a)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Establish procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.

clauses.title: § 164.312(a)(2)(iii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Terminate an electronic session after a predetermined period of inactivity.

clauses.title: § 164.312(a)(2)(iv) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information as appropriate.

clauses.title: § 164.312(b) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems containing electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.312(c)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement policies and procedures that protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.

clauses.title: § 164.312(c)(2) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement electronic mechanisms to confirm that electronic protected health information has not been improperly altered or destroyed.

clauses.title: § 164.312(d) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Verify that a person or entity seeking access is who or what it claims to be.

clauses.title: § 164.312(e)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement technical security measures against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information transmitted over communications networks.

clauses.title: § 164.312(e)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement security measures to ensure electronic protected health information is not improperly modified during transmission.

clauses.title: § 164.312(e)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information when appropriate during transmission.

clauses.title: § 164.314(a)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Require business associate contracts and other arrangements to include applicable safeguards for electronic protected health information.

clauses.title: § 164.314(a)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Require a business associate to comply with applicable safeguards, flow down those requirements to subcontractors, and report security incidents to the covered entity.

clauses.title: § 164.314(a)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: A covered entity may use another arrangement that meets the referenced requirements in place of a business associate contract.

clauses.title: § 164.314(a)(2)(iii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Apply the applicable business associate contract requirements to agreements between a business associate and its subcontractors.

clauses.title: § 164.316(a) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the Security Rule.

clauses.title: § 164.316(b)(1) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Maintain written policies and procedures and written or electronic records of required actions and assessments.

clauses.title: § 164.316(b)(2)(i) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Retain required documentation for six years from creation or the date it was last in effect, whichever is later.

clauses.title: § 164.316(b)(2)(ii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Make documentation available to those responsible for implementing the procedures to which it relates.

clauses.title: § 164.316(b)(2)(iii) Security Rule clause
clauses.text: Review and update documentation periodically and when environmental or operational changes affect security.
